description.en: No sharp edges, just a pleasantly weighted, satin-smooth form that invites a calm moment every time you hold it. Consider it your gentle cue to slow down whenever you pull out your keys—a small, refreshing prompt to blend a cold smoothie and take a well-deserved break.
